lead_with.title: Start from his actual role
lead_with.text: Open by asking what he runs today. 'AB Bernstein' covers three different businesses: **AllianceBernstein** (asset management), **Bernstein Private Wealth**, and **Bernstein** research and cash equities (the JV with **Société Générale**). The Montreal pitch depends on which one.

lead_with.title: New York hours at about half the cost
lead_with.text: Montreal is in the **New York time zone**. A Finance Montréal-commissioned 2026 cost study puts a 150-person financial operation at about **US$18.9M/yr in Montreal vs US$35.3M in New York**. Quebec's **IFC tax credit** adds **24% of eligible salaries, up to C$18,000 per employee per year** (min. 6 eligible staff).

lead_with.title: His peers are already there
lead_with.text: **Société Générale** (Bernstein's JV partner), **BNP Paribas, Crédit Agricole, State Street and Morgan Stanley** already run teams in Montreal, in a **bilingual** market. Ask whether AB or Bernstein has ever looked at Montreal for research support, operations, data or technology roles.

company.text: **AllianceBernstein** is a US-listed global investment manager serving institutions, retail investors and private clients (**Bernstein Private Wealth**, US$156.3B AUM at end 2025). It has Benelux institutional coverage from the Netherlands. In **April 2024** AB and **Société Générale** launched **Bernstein**, a joint venture combining their cash equities and equity research businesses, with head offices in **New York** (North America) and **London** (Europe and Asia), hubs in Paris and Hong Kong, and **750+ employees**; SocGen's stated aim is to own **100% after five years**, subject to approvals. Leadership: **Onur Erzan** (chairman since January 2026) will also become **CEO on April 1, 2027**, succeeding **Seth Bernstein**, who stays on the board. Whether AB or Bernstein has a Canadian or Montreal presence is **to be confirmed**.

financials.text: **FY2025:** net revenues **US$4.53B** (+1%), GAAP operating income **US$1.05B** (margin 23.0%), adjusted operating margin **33.7%**; AUM **US$866.9B** at Dec 31, 2025 (+9%); net outflows **US$11.3B** (private wealth +US$2.4B inflows); **4,468 employees**; 2025 distribution **US$3.38/unit**. Bernstein Research Services was **deconsolidated in April 2024** into the Société Générale JV, so its revenue no longer appears in AB's figures. **Q3 2026** (published late Oct 2026): AUM **US$900.4B**, net inflows **US$6.6B**, net revenues **US$1.23B** (+7.8%), adjusted EPU **US$0.88**. Sources: AB 4Q25 release (Feb 5, 2026) and Q3 2026 earnings coverage.
